83 | 	/**
84 | 	Add random jitter to retry delays to prevent thundering herd problems.
85 | 
86 | 	When many clients retry simultaneously (e.g., after hitting a rate limit), they can overwhelm the server again. Jitter adds randomness to break this synchronization.
87 | 
88 | 	Set to `true` to use full jitter, which randomizes the delay between 0 and the computed delay.
89 | 
90 | 	Alternatively, pass a function to implement custom jitter strategies.
